title: Add CSV export to the invoices list
author: petra-dev

reviews.author: hbram
reviews.body: Matches what the description promises. Nice reuse of the list filters.

comments.author: quill-bot
comments.body: The streaming response sets no `Content-Disposition`; browsers will render the CSV inline instead of downloading it.

comments.author: petra-dev
comments.body: Fixed as suggested — added the header with a generated filename.

comments.author: hbram
comments.body: The filename interpolates the raw filter string; a filter containing a quote or newline produces a broken header.

comments.author: petra-dev
comments.body: Fixed differently — dropped the filter text from the filename entirely and used `invoices-<date>.csv`. Simpler and nothing to escape.

comments.author: quill-bot
comments.body: `csv_rows` loads the full result set before writing; a large filtered set will buffer in memory.

comments.author: petra-dev
comments.body: Fixed — reused the list endpoint's 500-row pagination helper so export batches the same way the list does.

comments.author: hbram
comments.body: Nit: `test_export_2` doesn't say what it covers.
